name: Bad Time Bug in Apartment 309
source:
Such is the plight of Bug, a nervous 30-something remote worker who's found herself mysteriously trapped in her admittedly roomy third floor studio apartment. 

But is the life a Bug really so bad? To find out, we turn to an autobiographical short film by the girl herself. Witness her plight, and make your own judgements about what kind of time she has.

[From [url=https://cryingrulesactually.itch.io/bad-time-bug]Itch.io[/url]]
